decisions: Owned match-payload locals are borrowed views; exactly one payload cleanup obligation owns sibling destruction.
Return cleanup must use moved field paths, not only whole-payload retained flags.
CSharp normal arm exit already excludes moved paths; explicit return both dropped transferred-owner siblings and independently dropped the whole payload.
CSharp cleanup now excludes borrowed views from local-owner destruction, and uses the existing retained partial-field cleanup for the payload obligation.

SLG OwnedDropRequest uses return edge and semantic moved member paths; emitDropGlue filters transferred fields. Pattern cleanup remains distinct from arm local cleanup. Current Native execution will qualify this existing source decision before any adjustment.
